description: Get US national debt history from the U.S. Treasury. frequency="daily" returns the Debt to the Penny series (every business day since 1993-04-01, components null before 2005-03-31; limit up to 100). frequency="annual" returns debt outstanding at each fiscal year end since 1790 — with limit=250 the complete 235-year series fits in one call. Most recent first; paginate by passing meta.next_end as the next "end".

end.description: Inclusive end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Pass meta.next_end here to get the next page.

frequency.description: "daily" = business-day Debt to the Penny (1993+); "annual" = fiscal-year-end series (1790+).

limit.description: Max records per page. Daily: 1-100 (default 30). Annual: 1-250 (default 100; 250 = whole series).

name: get_us_debt_history
title: US national debt history
